host: node packages/wasix-openssh/cert/run.mjs --tarball <package.tgz>: boots slicc-kernel Node entry with uplink to (1) an ephemeral host OpenSSH sshd (temp keys, loopback) and (2) a tiny host none-auth SSH test server (cert/none-auth-server.py; OpenSSH sshd cannot do none for a real account). Runs cert/*.mjs checklist.

patches.0001-wasix-stub-getrrsetbyname.patch: SSHFP/DNSSEC getrrsetbyname always ERRSET_FAIL (no resolv.h); ordinary DNS via kernel — exercised by ssh to sshd.cert.internal / none.cert.internal

checklist: ssh -V / ssh-keygen -t ed25519: versions and key file modes 0600 under slicc_fs
identity: $HOME used for ~/.ssh; default user from getpwuid (slicc_identity) or documented $USER / user@host fallback until H1
exec: ssh via uplink to host sshd — echo, exit codes, stdin/stdout pipe (≤1 MiB)
PTY ssh -t: stty size; local ^C hits local ssh (slicc-kernel#247 — tty_set cannot clear ISIG); escape ~. disconnects; no ssh patch
optional: scp/sftp round-trip ≤1 MiB if binaries shipped
optional: GIT_SSH_COMMAND=ssh + wasm-git clone of a bare repo over host sshd
